data.narrative:
Corvex Systems is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $5M+. The valuation analysis draws from a broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector universe of nine private companies and one public comparable (277810.KQ), though a tightly-filtered peer set of same-stage or adjacent-stage companies proved insufficient for direct median benchmarking.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total raised ($5M) as a proxy baseline and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $12M. The Peer-Median method was not applied due to insufficient narrow comparables: while 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, fewer than three datapoints aligned on stage, proximity, or valuation tier simultaneously. The broader sector comparables (Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and others) provide directional context but do not satisfy the threshold for reliable median triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a median point of $12M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single method rather than true triangulation; key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific company, technical risk in robotics hardware development, and the limited public comps in the sector. Additional funding rounds or comparable transactions would strengthen conviction in this valuation.
